messages:
Ava (CSM): Hi all — kicking off onboarding for Nereus Health (pilot). Goal: 30d activation delivering embeddings + search UI. Who can own product acceptance criteria and weekly demo slots?
Miguel (SE): I can own the technical acceptance (embedding quality + latency checks). Will pair with Priya on integration points.
Priya (Customer PM): I’ll own business success criteria and demo schedule. We should lock stakeholders for week1 + week3 demos.
Lana (Enablement): I’ll prepare Enablement playbook and a 45m workshop for the Nereus data team in week2. Need confirmation of their SME availability.
Ava (CSM): Nice — early risk: data-extract cadence might slip (Nereus legal still reviewing). If extract delayed >7d, backup plan is using synthetic dataset for validation.
Miguel (SE): Ack. I’ll draft a small validation harness for synthetic vs production embeds. Will post code snippet here.
Miguel (SE): ```bash
# quick validation harness
python validate_embeddings.py --input sample_rows.csv --model redwood-embed-v1 --threshold 0.78
```
Priya (Customer PM): Success criteria (draft): 1) Search MRR relevance >= 0.65 (NPS proxy), 2) 95th pct latency < 250ms for in-region queries, 3) successful week3 demo with product owners. Thoughts?
Lana (Enablement): Agree on criteria. For enablement I’ll track completion of: onboarding doc read (100%), workshop attendance (>=2 SME), and 3 runbook tasks completed by their engineers.
Ava (CSM): Timeline proposal: Week0 (this week) - data contract + stakeholders confirmed; Week1 - ingest + embeddings; Week2 - enablement + integration; Week3 - end-to-end demo + acceptance. If legal delays push ingest to Week2, shift demo to Week4.
Priya (Customer PM): Adding renewal-risk flag: medium — they’re evaluating multiple vendors; capture feedback in week3 demo and send one-pager ROI metrics.
Miguel (SE): I’ll set up a dedicated test namespace and share creds with their engineers. ETA: 48h after data arrives.
DeployBot: Ava created doc: https://redwood.docs/s/nerus-onboard-playbook (permissions: customer-success + eng-se) :white_check_mark:
Ava (CSM): Action items: @Priya lock stakeholders by EOD Fri; @Miguel prepare harness and env; @Lana publish workshop deck by Tue; I’ll draft ROI one-pager template.
Priya (Customer PM): On it — I’ll ping their Head of Product and copy legal contact.
Lana (Enablement): Deck draft will be in the doc by Monday COB.
Miguel (SE): Will push initial harness and a test dataset (synthetic) by tomorrow morning.
Ava (CSM): Thanks — I’ll run a short health-check call Thurs 10am to confirm week1 readiness. If any blockers pop up before then, drop them here with "BLOCKER" prefix.
Priya (Customer PM): Noted. Also proposing a short feedback capture form to send after week3 demo. I’ll draft it and link to the playbook.
Ava (CSM): Perfect — closing the loop: weekly sync cadence = Mon 30m standup, Thu 10am readiness call (light). Anything else?
Miguel (SE): No, good to go from my side.
Lana (Enablement): Nothing else.
Ava (CSM): Great, thanks team. Will update the playbook and ping once stakeholders are confirmed. :rocket:
